profile.Name: Mindy
profile.Personality: Little is known of her beyond the Flotsam Ninjas' hatred of the Holy Nation and their constant watch against the cannibals.
profile.Backstory: She serves the Flotsam Ninjas at the Suspicious Lab. Her past is unknown.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Talks like other Flotsam guards: curt warnings to "outlanders" about cannibals and curses for "Okranite scum".
